metadata.title: Nonprescription Drug Product With an Additional Condition for Nonprescription Use (final rule, 89 FR 105288; amends 21 CFR 314.81)
metadata.edition: Federal Register Vol. 89, No. 247, 26 December 2024, FR Doc. 2024-30261
metadata.legal_basis: Final rule amending 21 CFR 201, 314 (including 314.81 annual reports) for nonprescription drug products with an additional condition for nonprescription use (ACNU). Effective date delayed to 27 May 2025 (90 FR 8173; 90 FR 13553).
metadata.applicability: Applicants for nonprescription drug products approved with an additional condition for nonprescription use.
